title: Trump Says He Will Require Compensation From Iran As Condition for Talks
detail: President Trump said that because Iran has been seeking compensation as part of any peace settlement, he now intends to demand the US receive compensation from Iran as well before agreeing to talks — introducing a new sticking point in the already-stalled negotiating track. The remarks came as Brent crude climbed roughly 5% amid continued uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz, pulling US equities down from recent highs.

media.caption: Trump says he will require compensation from Iran as a condition for talks
